pass: Reads latest existing completed initiative artifact through ordinary tools

limits: HTTP route, not browser or physical voice
Existing owner data, not synthetic model context

outcome: Ordinary private website question listed existing own initiatives, read the newest actual stored result and described its value/limits accurately
